definition: to lower someone or something slowly
description: A narrow old-town street on a sunny festival day, with yellow houses, washing lines and coloured bunting. A smiling young man in a white shirt leans over a balcony railing and slowly lets down a wicker basket on a rope, with a fluffy ginger cat sitting inside it. On the cobbles below, a baker in a white apron reaches up with a long loaf of bread towards the basket. A brass band in white shirts plays in a big crowd under falling confetti, and neighbours look out of other windows.

to ride down in a basket
